title: Million Pot Game
tagline: A game where players try to hit exactly $1,000,000 in deposits to get the million pot prize.
description:
Million$ is a simple Web3 game where players try to reach exactly $1,000,000 in a shared pot and win the full amount.

The idea is very straightforward, but the challenge comes from the token price. Players deposit OG tokens, but the value in USD changes all the time based on the market.

This means it’s not only about how much you deposit, but also when you do it.

If the pot reaches exactly $1,000,000, the round is won. But if it goes over, the round fails and players can claim a refund of their tokens.

I tried to make the experience feel more like a game than a financial tool, focusing on tension, timing and interaction. There is also a round history and a simple commentator called Lady Milly, that reacts to what is happening in the game.

This project is an exploration of turning financial logic into something more interactive and fun.
how_its_made:
This project was built as my first real experience creating a full app using AI tools and my first web3 project.

I used 0G Labs during the whole process, from building the UI to fixing bugs and adding features. I don’t come from a strong development background, so this was a way to explore how far I could go using AI.

The frontend was built with 0G Labs technology using React and TypeScript, focusing on a clean and simple interface. The game logic is simulated on the frontend, including rounds, deposits, failures and refunds.

The pot value changes based on a mock OG token price, simulating how it would behave with a real oracle.

Lady Milly was added as a simple logic and fun component, not a real AI. She reacts to the game state and adds personality to the experience.

There were many moments where things broke and didn’t work as expected, but I kept iterating using prompts until everything was working.

For me, this project is not about being perfect, but about learning and building something real from an idea.
auto_summary: A React game simulates players depositing tokens into a shared pot that must hit exactly $1,000,000 without exceeding it.
